heroHeadline: Pakistan Kills 21 More TTP Militants in KP, Revises North Waziristan Infiltration Toll to 25 as Balochistan Toll Tops 60 Since Sep 2
heroSubtitle: September 6, 2026 is Day 9,100 since the US launched Operation Enduring Freedom and Day 194 of Pakistan's Operation Ghazab lil-Haq. ISPR says security forces killed 21 Fitna al-Khawarij militants across North Waziristan, Kohat and Dera Ismail Khan between September 3-5, and separately revised the toll from the August 31-September 1 North Waziristan cross-border infiltration attempt upward from 15 to 25. The announcement follows a bloody stretch in Balochistan: 12 militants killed in a Kalat intelligence-based operation on September 2, then a 72-hour, 48-militant sweep through September 4 spanning Quetta's Shaban area (26 killed), Mastung, Kalat and Sibi — where roughly 40 Baloch Liberation Army militants stormed the police station, a bank and the assistant commissioner's office in Bhag before being repelled after a two-hour gunfight that injured five. The BLA separately claims — unconfirmed by ISPR — that it killed 25 Pakistani soldiers in a Ziarat Cross convoy ambush and a Surab vehicle-bomb attack the same day. These military operations follow the August 30 UN warning that funding cuts have shut nearly 600 Afghan health facilities this year, leaving 3.7 million Afghan children acutely malnourished; no formal ceasefire or new Urumqi round has been confirmed.
